base_instance: R44AS critical parent with pivot x2

construction.for_each_root_v_and_j: add fresh z(v,j) and clauses (-v OR z(v,j)), (v OR -z(v,j))
construction.coupling: leaves are attached to the same five root variables moved by the base signed transport; this is not a variable-disjoint lift

criticality_lemma.statement: If F is delta*-critical and v occurs in F, adding fresh z with the two equality clauses (-v OR z),(v OR -z) yields a delta*-critical F' with delta*(F')=delta*(F)+1.
case_argument: Selecting no equality clause cannot exceed the old rank.
Selecting exactly one equality clause adds one clause and at least one fresh variable, so deficiency does not rise.
Selecting both equality clauses contributes +1 deficiency only when v is already present; if the old selected subformula is proper, old criticality supplies at least one unit of slack.
Only the full old formula plus both equality clauses reaches old rank+1.

transport_support_theorem.binary_clause_bijection: Under a signed permutation, distinct binary target clauses have distinct binary images. Every binary image must equal a binary source clause, and source/target binary-clause counts agree; therefore the binary clause sets are bijected.
transport_support_theorem.root_leaf_separation: For L>=2 every root has binary incidence degree at least 2L>=4, whereas every equality leaf has degree exactly 2. Binary-set bijection therefore maps roots to roots and leaves to leaves.
transport_support_theorem.restriction_to_base: A base clause contains roots only. Since equality clauses contain a leaf, a root-only image of a base clause can only be subsumed by an original sibling clause. Thus every extended transport restricts to a valid signed transport of the five-root R44AS sibling pair.
transport_support_theorem.base_certificate_import: R44BQ exact replay proves no B->A transport with support<=4 and no A->B signed transport at all on the five-root universe.
transport_support_theorem.all_roots_move: Hence every B_L->A_L transport moves all five roots.
transport_support_theorem.leaf_forcing: The two equality clauses for a root-leaf pair must map to the two equality clauses of the image root-leaf pair. If the root moves or sign-flips, every attached leaf must also move or sign-flip.
transport_support_theorem.upper_bound: Extend the R44BP base permutation pi by mapping each z(v,j) to sign(pi(v))*z(|pi(v)|,j). This is a valid transport with support exactly 5(L+1).
transport_support_theorem.reverse: No A_L->B_L transport exists, because restriction to roots would contradict the base reverse nonexistence theorem.

quantified_consequence: For every fixed K choose L>=max(2,ceil(K/5)). Then this maxdef-critical sibling pair admits no signed-permutation safe-delete transport of support<=K in either direction.
remaining_open: Polynomial discovery of unbounded-support signed transport by a different method.
More general substitutions, affine transports, or model maps not induced by signed permutations.
Universal destructive normalization outside this transport class.
